{{Quote|You're aware, Waste, that you still haven't answered my initial question?''"<br />"''Excuse me?''"<br />"''Are we there yet?''"<br />"''Dr. Cody, if you're referring to our ETA at Detention Moon Gradient Seven&mdash;''"<br />"''The ''Purge'' is a prison barge, Waste. '''Gradient Seven''' was a [[detainment moon]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], to house prisoners. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] was sent to transport prisoners to Gradient Seven, although it never arrived there.

{{Moon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that Gradient Seven was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was a military code name.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
